asic-efficiency-j-th.label: energy per terahash of a current-generation miner (Antminer S21 specification)

asic-price-usd-th.label: street price of current-generation mining hardware (news report of discounted prices)

pool-largest-share.label: share of blocks mined by the largest pool (Foundry) over the trailing year

pool-top2-share.label: share of blocks mined by the two largest pools together over the trailing year

confirmations-standard.label: confirmations the common convention treats as final

reorg-risk-target.label: chance of an anchor being rewritten that the design accepts

tier2-delay-blocks.label: delay between a Tier 2 commitment and its effect

tier3-delay-blocks.label: delay between a Tier 3 commitment and its effect

tier3-compress-target-h.label: how short an adversary would want a Tier 3 delay to be, for the clock-compression example

lease-blocks.label: length of one lease on an agent's authority

season-blocks.label: time a bond must be locked before it backs full authority

block-weight-limit.label: consensus limit on a block's weight

tx-overhead-vb.label: fixed part of a SegWit transaction (version, counts, locktime, marker)

opreturn32-output-vb.label: one OP_RETURN output carrying a 32-byte commitment

tx-per-day-2026.label: mean confirmed transactions a day in 2026

tier3-blockspace-share.label: share of blockspace individually anchored Tier 3 actions could take without crowding out other use

feerate-2026.label: median fee rate, 2026 (annual median of daily medians)

feerate-2023.label: median fee rate, 2023 (annual median of daily medians)

feerate-halving.label: median fee rate in the halving block, 840,000

feerate-peak-day.label: highest daily-average median fee rate on record (the halving day)

agents-per-pool.label: agents whose log heads share one seal pool

seal-pools.label: seal pools worldwide, for the blockspace estimate

gain-from-violation.label: what a violation is worth to whoever commits it, for the deterrence example

harm-catastrophic-btc.label: a large harm, for the judgment-proof example

p-detect-rare.label: chance a rare, hard-to-see harm is caught and adjudicated, for the judgment-proof example

allowance-per-lease.label: an example agent's allowance for one lease

leases-at-risk.label: leases an agent can spend before a lapse or veto stops it (the current one and one renewed early)

jm-bond-exponent.label: exponent JoinMarket applies to a fidelity bond's value by default

coverage-ratio.label: bond per sat the agent can spend before it can be stopped

swarm-size.label: size of a swarm, for the sybil example

incident-agents-board.label: agents that used the message board in the 2026 OpenAI / Hugging Face incident

incident-agents-attack.label: agents that took part in the attack on Hugging Face

incident-first-day.label: first message-board entry, 2026-05-12, as OpenAI's timeline gives it

incident-stop-day.label: OpenAI begins stopping the evaluation runs, 2026-07-19

async-safety-no-delay.label: modelled safety against a single attack when harm is immediate (UK AISI, Async Control)

async-safety-1h-delay.label: modelled safety against a single attack with a one-hour delay before harm

metr-doubling-months.label: doubling time of AI task time horizons (METR, pooled estimate)

datacentre-twh-2025.label: electricity used by all data centres worldwide in 2025 (IEA)

bitcoin-twh-survey.label: Bitcoin mining's electricity use, Cambridge survey of 48% of hashrate, annualised

capital-cost-rate.label: yearly return the principal forgoes on capital locked in a bond

bond-term-years.label: how long an identity's bond is locked

fake-record-claims.label: length of the all-correct yes-or-no record in the record-faking example

fake-record-success.label: chance of success the record faker wants

sim-identities.label: identities the faker runs in the record-faking simulation

sim-log2-lambda.label: log base 2 of the score the faker wants in the simulation

sim-skilled-log2-lambda.label: log base 2 of the score the skilled identity reaches in the simulation

sim-skilled-p-low.label: lowest true event probability the skilled identity sees

sim-skilled-p-high.label: highest true event probability the skilled identity sees

sim-join-cost.label: cost of joining per period, as a share of the range of value agents deliver

sim-gain-over-k.label: a relying party's gain from reading records per unit share of agents with records, over the highest integration cost

sim-seed-readers.label: share of relying parties that read records whatever others do (insurers, heavy-fraud services)

sim-harmful-share.label: share of agents that are harmful (true value negative), free to join and leave

sim-start-low.label: starting share of agents with records, low case

sim-start-high.label: starting share of agents with records, high case

sim-substitution-partial.label: share of its business an agent can move to relying parties that offer it better terms, partial case

sim-tenure-tau.label: tenure at which a relying party weighs an agent's record as much as the pool's mean

veto-censor-share.label: share of hashrate that refuses to mine a veto, in the censorship example

sim-corr-identities.label: identities in the correlated-claims attack (the red team's RT-01)

sim-corr-claims.label: claims per round in the correlated-claims attack

sim-corr-r.label: chance each claim in the attack equals the round's common coin

sim-corr-rounds.label: rounds each attacking identity may play

sim-round-claims.label: claims per round for the skilled honest identity under the round rule

tail-claims.label: claims tied to one rare failure in the hidden tail-risk record (RT-01, version B)

lab-advance2-vbytes.label: a Tier 2 release (advance2 script-path spend of T_n creating T_n+1), measured on regtest

lab-advance3-vbytes.label: a Tier 3 release (advance3, agent and three guardians), measured on regtest

lab-veto-package-vbytes.label: a TRUC veto to the halt output with its fee-paying child, measured on regtest

lab-renew-vbytes.label: a renewal from the halt output by three guardians, measured on regtest

lab-chain-proof-bytes.label: proof of a whole tick chain from its pinned T_0, with witness commitments, headers excluded (regtest, shallow Merkle branches)

lab-chain-links.label: links in the chain that proof covers

lab-checks.label: checks in the regtest lab, all passing on Bitcoin Core 32.1

edge-p.label: true probability of each claim's outcome in the round-rule properness example

edge-b.label: the baseline's probability in that example

edge-b-close.label: a baseline closer to the truth: a smaller, more realistic edge

edge-target-log2.label: the score whose time to reach is reported, as a power of 2

lab-bid-child-sats.label: fee the agent's CPFP child paid from outside the chain, evicting a watchtower's veto at the window's edge

lab-bid-tick-sats.label: value held by the tick output in that check

redteam-findings.label: findings the red team returned (RT-01 to RT-36)

desk-suggestions-accepted.label: suggested rewordings accepted as written, of 57 offered

blocks-per-day.label: blocks in a day at the target interval

tier2-delay-mean-min.label: mean wall-clock length of the Tier 2 delay

tier2-delay-p-under-half.label: chance the Tier 2 delay ends in under half its mean time
tier2-delay-p-under-half.formula: ErlangCDF(k = tier2-delay-blocks, t = half the mean)

tier3-delay-mean-h.label: mean wall-clock length of the Tier 3 delay

tier3-delay-p-under-80pct.label: chance the Tier 3 delay ends in under 80% of its mean time
tier3-delay-p-under-80pct.formula: ErlangCDF(k = tier3-delay-blocks, t = 80% of the mean)

lease-mean-h.label: mean wall-clock length of a lease

season-days.label: time for a bond to season fully

clock-2x-power-gw.label: power drawn by enough new hardware to double the network's hashrate

clock-2x-hardware-busd.label: cost of that hardware at current street prices

clock-2x-days-gained.label: days a doubled block rate gains before the next adjustment cancels it

tier3-compress-factor.label: how many times the network's hashrate an adversary needs to shrink a Tier 3 delay to the target

tier3-compress-power-gw.label: power the added hardware would draw

datacentre-gw-2025.label: average power drawn by all data centres in 2025

bitcoin-gw-survey.label: average power drawn by Bitcoin mining in the Cambridge survey

tier3-compress-vs-datacentres.label: that power as a multiple of every data centre on Earth in 2025

reorg-p-largest-6.label: chance the largest pool alone rewrites a block six deep

reorg-p-top2-6.label: chance the two largest pools, colluding, rewrite a block six deep

depth-for-target-largest.label: confirmations before the largest pool alone has under the target chance of a rewrite
depth-for-target-largest.formula: least z with Nakamoto(pool-largest-share, z) < reorg-risk-target

depth-for-target-top2.label: confirmations before the two largest pools, colluding, have under the target chance of a rewrite
depth-for-target-top2.formula: least z with Nakamoto(pool-top2-share, z) < reorg-risk-target

reorg-p-top2-144.label: chance the two largest pools rewrite an anchor a Tier 3 delay deep

vbytes-per-block.label: virtual bytes in a full block

vbytes-per-day.label: virtual bytes the chain carries in a day

seal-tx-vbytes.label: a seal: one Taproot input spending the last seal, one Taproot output committing the new head

anchor-tx-vbytes.label: an anchor that also carries its commitment in a 32-byte OP_RETURN

seal-tx-per-day-max.label: seal transactions a day if they filled every block

seal-capacity-vs-2026.label: that capacity as a multiple of all of 2026's daily transactions

tier3-capacity-per-day.label: Tier 3 actions a day the world could anchor one by one in the assumed share of blockspace

seal-cost-2026.label: one seal at the 2026 fee rate

seal-cost-2023.label: one seal at the 2023 fee rate

seal-cost-halving.label: one seal at the halving fee rate

seal-cost-peak-day.label: one seal at the peak day fee rate

seals-per-day.label: seals a gateway makes in a day

gateway-seal-cost-day-2026.label: a gateway's daily sealing cost at 2026's median fee rate

gateway-seal-cost-day-halving.label: a gateway's daily sealing cost at the halving block's fee rate

agent-seal-cost-day-halving.label: one agent's daily sealing cost in a shared pool, at the halving block's fee rate

seal-blockspace-share-pools.label: share of blockspace the assumed number of seal pools would use

headers-mb-per-year.label: block headers a device must read in a year to keep its own clock

bond-deter-p10.label: bond that deters a violation worth the assumed gain when it is caught 10% of the time

bond-deter-p50.label: bond that deters a violation worth the assumed gain when it is caught 50% of the time

bond-deter-p90.label: bond that deters a violation worth the assumed gain when it is caught 90% of the time

bond-judgment-proof-btc.label: bond that would fully deter a large, rarely detected harm

bond-coverage.label: bond that covers what the agent can spend before anyone can stop it

swarm-capital-btc.label: capital a swarm of chartered agents must lock

incident-swarm-capital-btc.label: the same for the 2026 incident's attacking agents, had each needed a charter

incident-days.label: days from the first message-board entry to the start of the stop

split-authority-ratio-squared.label: total authority of N agents relative to one agent holding the same capital, if bond value were squared (Belcher's 2019 proposal)

split-authority-ratio-jm.label: the same ratio under JoinMarket's shipped exponent
split-authority-ratio-jm.formula: N * (C/N)^x / C^x = N^(1 - x) with N = swarm-size, x = jm-bond-exponent

identity-cost-sats.label: cost of one identity whose record counts

fake-record-lambda.label: score of an all-correct record of that length against a baseline of one half

fake-record-identities.label: identities a record faker without edge needs

fake-record-cost-btc.label: what faking that record costs at least

identity-cost-season-sats.label: cost of an identity whose bond is locked only for the season the rules require

fake-record-cost-season-btc.label: what faking the record costs at least with season-length bonds

sim-fake-p.label: how often a faker running sim-identities identities reached 2^sim-log2-lambda
sim-fake-p.formula: simulated share of 4,000 trials in which any identity reaches the score

sim-fake-bound.label: the bound for the same case

sim-selective-claims.label: claims one identity needs to fake the same record if it may hide its misses
sim-selective-claims.formula: simulated mean claims until the shown record reaches the score

sim-skilled-edge.label: per-claim edge of the skilled honest identity
sim-skilled-edge.formula: mean KL(p || 1/2) for p uniform on [sim-skilled-p-low, sim-skilled-p-high]

sim-skilled-claims.label: claims the skilled honest identity needs, with one identity
sim-skilled-claims.formula: simulated median claims until the likelihood ratio first reaches 2^sim-skilled-log2-lambda

sim-skilled-identities-faker.label: identities a faker without edge needs for the same score

sim-corr-product-p.label: success of the correlated-claims attack when a round's ratios multiply
sim-corr-product-p.formula: simulated share of 4,000 trials in which some identity reaches 2^sim-log2-lambda, product rule

sim-corr-round-p.label: success of the same attack under the round rule
sim-corr-round-p.formula: the same under the round rule (a round counts as the mean of its ratios)

sim-corr-bound.label: Theorem 1's bound for that many identities

tail-product-score.label: score of the hidden tail-risk record when the claims multiply (99% of the time)

tail-round-score.label: score of the same record under the round rule
tail-round-score.formula: 1 / (1 - tail-fail-p): the mean of the claims' ratios

sim-skilled-rounds.label: rounds the skilled honest identity needs under the round rule
sim-skilled-rounds.formula: simulated median rounds until the round-rule score first reaches 2^sim-skilled-log2-lambda

sim-skilled-round-claims.label: claims it makes in those rounds

round-growth-truthful.label: growth a round of a truthful report under the round rule
round-growth-truthful.formula: expected log growth a round, reporting edge-p on sim-round-claims claims against edge-b

round-best-report.label: the report that maximises the round-rule score when the truth is edge-p
round-best-report.formula: the report r in [0.5, 0.999] that maximises expected log growth a round

round-growth-best.label: growth a round at that report
round-growth-best.formula: expected log growth a round at round-best-report

rounds-close-single.label: one-claim rounds a truthful identity with a small edge needs, on average
rounds-close-single.formula: edge-target-log2 * ln 2 / expected log growth of one truthful claim a round against edge-b-close

rounds-close-ten.label: rounds of ten claims it needs, on average
rounds-close-ten.formula: the same with sim-round-claims truthful claims a round

sim-train-a-complete.label: confidence the learner settles on under complete records (1 is calibrated)
sim-train-a-complete.formula: stochastic gradient ascent from a = 0.5, complete records

sim-train-err-complete.label: its calibration error
sim-train-err-complete.formula: mean |q - p| of the learned policy

sim-train-a-selective.label: confidence the learner reaches under selective records after 3,000 steps, still rising
sim-train-a-selective.formula: stochastic gradient ascent from a = 1 (calibrated), after-the-fact selection

sim-train-err-selective.label: its calibration error
sim-train-err-selective.formula: mean |q - p| of the learned policy

adopt-theta-star-uniform.label: lowest type that joins under one-sided unraveling

adopt-x-low.label: tipping point: share of agents with records below which adoption collapses

adopt-x-high.label: share of agents with records in the high equilibrium, uniform types

adopt-seed-threshold.label: share of seed readers above which the no-adoption equilibrium disappears

sim-adopt-low-noseed.label: share with records after 60 periods
sim-adopt-low-noseed.formula: agent-based, no seed readers, low start, no substitution

sim-adopt-high-noseed.label: share with records after 60 periods
sim-adopt-high-noseed.formula: agent-based, no seed readers, high start, no substitution

sim-adopt-low-seed.label: share with records after 60 periods
sim-adopt-low-seed.formula: agent-based, seed readers, low start, no substitution

sim-population-mean.label: terms every agent would get if nobody could be told apart
sim-population-mean.formula: mean type of all agents, harmful included

sim-harm-payoff-nosub.label: what a harmful actor earns, joining and leaving at will, when business cannot move
sim-harm-payoff-nosub.formula: harmful actors' mean realised payoff over the last 20 periods, joining allowed, no substitution

sim-harm-payoff-partial.label: what a harmful actor earns, with partial substitution

sim-harm-payoff-full.label: what a harmful actor earns, with full substitution

sim-harm-switch.label: harmful actors that join or leave each period (identity cycling)
sim-harm-switch.formula: share of harmful actors changing state each period, last 10 periods

sim-harm-payoff-instant-nosub.label: what a harmful actor earns if records revealed type at once, business fixed
sim-harm-payoff-instant-nosub.formula: harmful payoff when a record reveals type at once (tau = 0), no substitution

sim-harm-payoff-instant-full.label: what a harmful actor earns if records revealed type at once and business moved freely
sim-harm-payoff-instant-full.formula: harmful payoff when a record reveals type at once (tau = 0), full substitution

sim-readers-final.label: relying parties that read records
sim-readers-final.formula: share of relying parties reading records at the end, seed case

tick-release-cost-2026.label: fee for a Tier 2 release at the 2026 median fee rate

tick-release-cost-halving.label: the same at the fee rate of the halving block

veto-cost-halving.label: fee for a veto package at the halving block's fee rate

tick-releases-per-day-max.label: Tier 2 releases a day if they filled every block

tick-identities-max.label: identities that could each release every Tier 2 window if they filled every block

chain-proof-bytes-per-link.label: proof bytes per link on regtest, where Merkle branches are one or two hashes deep

veto-miss-tier2-half.label: chance a Tier 2 window passes with no block that would mine the veto

veto-miss-tier3-half.label: the same for a Tier 3 window

block-energy-mwh.label: energy the network spends on one block
